subject: Executive slate: signer rotation and offer timeline (Q3 hires)
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive slate: signer rotation and offer timeline (Q3 hires)

Team — attaching the proposed Q3 executive hiring slate and a clean set of offer templates. Two asks: (1) confirm the signer rotation so we can get DocuSign envelopes out without bottleneck, and (2) confirm final comp bands for the four exec roles so Recruiting can start verbal offers.

High level: 4 executive roles recommended this quarter — EVP Product, VP Eng (infra), Head of Sales Ops, and Director of Customer Security (senior IC). We propose this signer rotation: CEO (vivek) signs EVP Product & Head of Sales Ops; CRO (marcus) signs VP Eng if the role reports into infrastructure/ops; CFO (laura) okays comp bands sign-off for all hires for budget confirmation. If any of you want delegation to a proxy for specific offers, note below — I want Docusign-ready signers assigned by EOD Monday 2/20.

Key constraints and asks:
- Compensation: see tab "Bands" in Q3_executive_slate.xlsx — please call out any exceptions to recommended bands by Monday noon.
- Budget: Laura, can you confirm runway impact and whether we should hold VP Eng until headcount refresh?
- Recruiting: Heidi Morales (recruiter) is standing by to start verbal offers once signers and bands are confirmed.

Attachments: Q3_executive_slate.xlsx, offer_templates_v6.docx

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Talent, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive slate: signer rotation and offer timeline (Q3 hires)

Lauren — thanks for pulling this together. Quick note inline: for EVP Product I’d recommend moving the midpoint up by one decile relative to the sheet — candidate pool will need to be competitive. Also suggest we include an explicit relocation allowance line for product leadership; recruiters often miss that in verbal offers.

If we do that, I approve the proposed signer rotation (CEO for EVP). No delegation needed from me.

On the VP Eng role: if Marcus expects budget hesitation, we can split hiring into two phased starts (director -> VP) but prefer to keep the role open.

— Aditya

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive slate: signer rotation and offer timeline (Q3 hires)

Agree with Aditya on EVP comp. I can sign the VP Eng if the role remains scoped to infra and ops; however, I want to flag budget sensitivity on the VP Eng and Director of Customer Security roles. Laura — can you confirm whether we have headroom or if we should push VP Eng into Q4?

If Laura gives the green light, I delegate signing authority for VP Eng to me for offers up to 18 months base + target equity band as listed. Anything outside that gets routed to Vivek.

Marcus Lin
CRO (acting)
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive slate: signer rotation and offer timeline (Q3 hires)

Thanks — reviewed the slate and the runway model (attached: budget_runrate_q3.pdf). We have capacity for two of these four hires this quarter without taking additional runway risk. Approved: EVP Product and Head of Sales Ops. Please go ahead on those two and use the standard offer_templates_v6.docx.

For VP Eng (infra) I recommend we pause and re-evaluate in 6 weeks; pushing to Q4 lowers near-term risk. Director of Customer Security can be approved on the condition it comes in at or below the target band (no signing bonuses).

I will notate approvals in the compensation tracker and update the headcount forecast. Lauren — please update the slate file to reflect approvals and flagged items.

Laura Bennett
CFO, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Heidi Morales <heidi@recruiters.co>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Exec slate — approvals recorded; next steps for offers

Thanks all — summary and actions: 
- Approved to proceed this quarter: EVP Product (Vivek signs), Head of Sales Ops (Vivek signs).
- Conditional approval: Director of Customer Security (Laura approves if no signing bonus).
- Deferred: VP Eng (infra) — move to Q4 cadence; recruiting to pause outreach for senior hires for this role.

Actions for Recruiting (Heidi): please prepare verbal offers using offer_templates_v6.docx and include the relocation allowance line for EVP Product as discussed. Send initial verbal offers today for EVP Product & Head of Sales Ops. Once candidate accepts, route DocuSign envelopes to Vivek for signature (I will prepare envelopes and pre-fill compensation lines).

I have uploaded the updated slate as Q3_executive_slate_v2.xlsx to our docs and linked the DocuSign envelope placeholder here: https://docusign.com/envelope/ENVELOPE-78910

I'll close the loop when envelopes are out. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Lauren
Head of Talent
